profile.summary: Daylight Foods is a food service distributor in Northern California that supplies fresh produce and other ingredients to foodservice customers. It runs its own processing plant and a fleet of temperature-controlled delivery vehicles from a facility in Union City. Its website also lists school programs among its services.
